question: For a known synthetic image-plane projected-court translation of the G233d/G247 seed map, which fixed projection signals distinguish a nonzero rung from the 0 px control?

perturbation.definition: Let H be the persisted G247 image-to-court matrix and P=inverse(H). For rung N, render/project with P_N=T(N,0)P, where T(N,0) translates image coordinates N pixels camera-right. Measure using H_N=inverse(P_N). Every finite projected court point moves exactly N horizontal image pixels.

control_repeats.definition: Five independently streamed ffmpeg select=eq(n,19599) decodes of the same named frame, retained only in worker memory. They estimate source-decode and measurement-route spread without changing the map or relabeling.

fixed_methods.offset: G252 Canny low=50 high=150 aperture=3 L2gradient=true; 4 px projected sampling; integer normal search -24..+24; retain no-candidate count; conditional found distances are right-censored at 24 px.
fixed_methods.image_agreement: G248 edge-response and marking contrast use 3 px and 9 px controls on both normal sides; LSD_REFINE_STD agreement has 4 px distance and 15 degree unoriented tangent tolerance; projected geometry samples every 2 px.
fixed_methods.quad: G247 role order and perimeter [0,1,3,2], convexity, signed area, winding, corner order, area ratio, aspect ratio, outside-corner fraction, and normalized 3x3 condition number.

detection_rule_before_measurement.definition: For each stated scalar, a rung is detected only if its five-repeat median differs from the 0 px five-repeat median by more than max(three times the 0 px repeat range, practical_floor), and every rung repeat is strictly outside the 0 px repeat min-to-max interval in that same direction. This is a sensitivity declaration, not a production threshold and is never used to report ladder accuracy.

primary_scalars.offset: pooled found-distance p90; practical_floor=1.0 px; a rung with p90=24 px is censored/saturated and cannot establish resolution at that rung

detection_rule_before_measurement.saturation: Any offset scalar at the 24 px search bound is right-censored and is reported as saturation, not detection. Other signals have no fixed measurement ceiling; a mathematically invariant quad scalar is reported invariant rather than detected.

monotonicity: Report Spearman rho over the seven rung medians in stated displacement order. For the offset primary, also state whether medians are nondecreasing. Rho is descriptive only and is not a detection criterion.
limits: One G233d seed, one frame, one clip, one arena, and five repeated decodes; no population inference.
The 0 px control is only as good as the seed, which G257 constrains to roughly 20 px by eye.
Synthetic uniform translation is not a real non-uniform calibration error.
Detecting displacement from a known start is easier than validating an unknown map and does not bear on automatic calibration, which remains 0/17.
